raw.room_reading: The kitchen is a large square with walls measuring 4100 mm each. It has four windows and a solid floor. The room is 172 sqft with a height of 2500 mm. The customer needs include tall storage, a slab door style, and a preference for auto-lay
raw.design_plan: I will place the hob and sink along one of the longer walls, leaving the other walls for storage and appliances. I will use a mix of drawer and shutter cabinets to maximize storage and functionality.
raw.layout_why: The large open space and multiple windows make it ideal for a central cooking area with ample storage on both sides.
raw.sink_why: The sink will be placed on Wall 1 to provide better access for food preparation and dishwashing.
raw.hob_why: The hob will be placed on Wall 2 near the center for even heat distribution and accessibility.
raw.lpg_why: The LPG cylinder unit is included as per rule R11.
raw.tall_why: The customer needs mention tall cabinets, so I will include one on each side of the hob.
raw.purifier_why: Water purifier is not stated, but it's a common appliance, so I will include it.
raw.display_why: Glass display unit is not stated, but it can add aesthetics and utility to the kitchen, so I will include it.
raw.open_why: No open shelf unit is mentioned, but it can be useful for display or additional storage, so I will include it.
raw.storage_why: To maximize storage and functionality, I will use a mix of drawer and shutter cabinets.
raw.features_why: The customer prefers auto-layout, so I will include a spice pullout, a water purifier, a glass display unit, and an open shelf unit.
raw.wall_cabinets_why: The customer prefers a mix of drawer and shutter cabinets.
raw.wall_style_why: The customer prefers a slab door style for the wall cabinets.
raw.finish_why: The customer does not specify finishes, so I will choose a modern and durable finish.
raw.loft_why: The room is large, and lofts can add storage and functionality, but they are not mandatory.
